terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.content:
1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing and using RensChat, you agree to be bound by the applicable terms and conditions.

2. Use of Service

RensChat is a generative AI assistant. You are prohibited from using this service to generate illegal content, infringe copyrights, or harm others.

3. Limitation of Liability

AI can make mistakes. Always verify important information generated by the system. We are not liable for any damages arising from the use of AI results.

4. AI-Generated Media

Images and videos generated by RensChat are created by AI models (FLUX.2 Klein, FLUX.3 Image Klein, NVIDIA Cosmos3 Nano, or graphic animations generated from Python code). All media is AI-generated and may contain visual inaccuracies. You are fully responsible for the use of generated results, including compliance with related model licenses.

SynthID Watermark on Cosmos3 Nano output must not be removed. The watermark is an indicator that the media is AI-generated.

5. Media Retention (24 Hours)

Generated media (images and videos) is stored for a maximum of 24 hours from creation, then automatically deleted from storage. Download the media you need before it expires. After expiration, media cannot be recovered and you need to regenerate it.

6. Donations (Optional)

All core RensChat features remain free. Donations via Ko-fi are optional and serve to unlock heavier models (FLUX.3 Image Klein for images, NVIDIA Cosmos3 Nano for videos). One donation (minimum USD 3) gives +10 FLUX.3 image credits and +4 Cosmos video credits at once. Credits accumulate and do not expire; failed generations will refund credits. Donations are not purchases; credits are not currency and cannot be cashed out.

7. Model Attribution & Licenses

FLUX images are generated via NVIDIA API. FLUX.3 Image Klein is subject to the FLUX Kommunity License v1.0. Cosmos videos are generated via NVIDIA API Trial Terms. Free path video animations are generated from Python code executed in an isolated sandbox and stitched via ffmpeg. All usage is subject to the respective model providers' terms.

8. Service Changes

We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue the service at any time without prior notice.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
1. Data We Collect

We collect your email address, name, and chat history (including uploaded files) to provide a better service. For AI-generated media, we store technical metadata (model, dimensions, duration) without storing full prompts in logs.

2. Data Usage

Your data is used exclusively to process AI requests, store chat history, and improve model quality. We DO NOT sell your data to third parties.

3. Donation Data

To map donations to accounts, we store hashed donor emails (SHA-256) and Ko-fi transaction IDs. Raw emails and webhook verification tokens are not stored or logged. You can also choose to match donations via the donation code RC-XXXXXX written in the donation message.

4. Security

All data is encrypted in transit (HTTPS) and stored in secure cloud infrastructure (MongoDB & Cloudflare R2).

5. Data Deletion

You can delete chat sessions at any time through the interface. Deleting a session will permanently remove chat history and related files from the server. Generated media is automatically deleted 24 hours after creation.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.content:
What is RensChat?

RensChat is an AI assistant that not only replies with text but can also render interactive tables, charts, cards, create files, and generate images and videos directly within the chat.

Is my data safe?

Yes. We use secure JWT authentication and files are stored in private storage (Cloudflare R2). Read more in our Privacy Policy.

What file formats are supported?

Currently we support PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT, Markdown, JSON, as well as images (PNG, JPG). For generated media, the output is images (PNG/JPEG/WebP) and MP4 videos.

Are AI-generated images and videos free?

FLUX.2 Klein 4B images and Python videos (graphic animations generated from code) are completely free with a daily limit. FLUX.3 Image Klein images and NVIDIA Cosmos3 Nano videos require credits obtained through optional Ko-fi donations. All core features remain free without donation.

How long is my media stored?

All generated media is stored for a maximum of 24 hours from creation, then automatically deleted. Download the media you need before it expires. After expiration, media cannot be recovered and needs to be regenerated.

Is AI-generated media legal to use?

FLUX.3 image models are subject to the FLUX Kommunity License v1.0, while Cosmos videos are subject to the NVIDIA API Trial Terms. Cosmos video output includes a SynthID watermark that must not be removed. Always check model licenses before commercial use. Details in Terms & Conditions.

How to claim donation credits?

After donating, write the donation code RC-XXXXXX (available in the account menu) in the Ko-fi donation message — credits will be added automatically. If you forgot to write the code, open the account menu → Donation (optional) → Claim donation and enter your email + Ko-fi transaction ID.

Why is the AI sometimes wrong?

Large language models (LLMs) can hallucinate. We have added a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) feature to minimize this, but always double-check critical information.
